summary: Defines the profile link relation type, which lets a representation indicate that it follows one or more profiles. A profile does not change the meaning of the representation but tells clients about extra constraints, conventions or extensions. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A label on a box that says how it is packed, so you know the extra rules for opening it, though the box is the same box.
